name: slopify
description: Outcome-driven engineering and research through explicitly invoked workflows: shape turns an idea into a story with observable acceptance criteria; deliver-story, deliver-trivial, deliver-bugfix, and deliver-spike take a story, a small change, a bug, or a question to a reviewed PR or a findings document; validate runs a project's validation on a branch or PR; reproduce-bug reproduces a report and files it; review-pr runs the PR review loop; research investigates new sources and persists cited evidence in the project library. Skills: ask answers from the library, lint checks and repairs it, bootstrap sets up the board and forge declarations and the library. Agents: single-task scouts (gather), lenses (validate), and advisors (judge); designer, coder, and writer (produce); judge (rules on findings); qa and validator (validate code); pusher (the only board and forge operator); watcher (waits for reviews); auditor (validates setup); and the library agents.
